packet.title: Source locations for parsed input documents (design and implementation)

body.p: After , and perf-8 (which holds src/evaluator.c and src/evaluator_function.c). settles the behaviour: a processor setting AUTOMATIC (the zero value), ALWAYS, NEVER; under AUTOMATIC documents a host parses keep locations, and where sxml parses for a program the compiled program decides (it calls fn:location, can reach functions dynamically, or is a validation); dynamic errors that name an input node print its line and column; --locations= in the sxml command, the same three values in JavaScript. Today sxml_processor_parse_document sets keeps_locations = false (src/processor.c), so fn:location is the empty sequence for every input document; the arena tree and the parser already support locations.

item.p: Design: the field in sxml_processor_configuration (include/sxml/processor.h, additive after , with its decision record); one flag per compiled unit (XPath, XQuery, XSLT) that the lowering sets; where fn:doc, fn:parse-xml and fn:collection read it; xpath and xquery in the sxml command compile before they parse --context-item; which error records gain the location.

Owns: include/sxml/processor.h (the new field), src/processor.c, the parts of the lowering that set the flag, the call sites of fn:doc, fn:parse-xml and fn:collection, apps/sxml/query_command.c, apps/sxml/command_xpath.c, apps/sxml/command_xquery.c, apps/sxml/command_transform.c (option only), docs/CLI.md, the JavaScript package's option, tests.

Done when: location(.) gives line and column for the context item, fn:doc and a stylesheet's input under AUTOMATIC in a program that calls it, and nothing is kept for one that cannot ask (memory measured both ways on the 26 MB document of ); errors print locations; QT4 and XT40 unchanged case by case; the book's examples match.

body.p: Done 2026-10-28 (): sxml_source_location_policy and sxml_node_get_location (additive); a flag per IR unit set where expressions are added, the processor's location demand, copies that keep locations; --locations in xpath, xquery and transform, which compile first; errors name a node's line; createProcessor({ locations }) (not built here: no WASI SDK). 173 MB without fn:location, 249 MB with, on the 26 MB document; XP40, XQ40, XT40 identical case by case.
